source_caption:
Clayface is bringing pure, unhinged body horror back to the big screen.

Directed by James Watkins and written by Mike Flanagan, this psychological thriller follows an actor whose life spirals into madness after a terrifying transformation leaves his body altered and his sanity completely unraveled.

With visceral practical effects, shocking transformations, and relentless chaotic energy, this is shaping up to be one of the most unsettling theater experiences of the year and honestly, I couldn't be more hyped for it.

🎟️ TICKETS ARE ON SALE NOW. Clayface hits theaters October 23.
